name: Uma Girish
reason: Health rule (judgement call, flagged for the owner): her own site (umagirish.com) presents her as a mentor for grieving women and her work, free download, Substack ('Light After Loss') and Shift course ('Transform Grief & Pain Into Purpose & Joy') are all framed around grief and loss and healing from it. The brief treats grief therapy as condition framing and skips a teacher whose work is mainly that. Her books are a Hay House memoir and Lessons From Grace; if the owner reads grief companioning as spiritual mentoring, she could be re-run.
